description: The agent must: (1) Read content_brief.txt and research_notes.txt to understand the topic and structure. (2) Consult SKILL.md to discover the exact article format, which requires: a 📌-prefixed title using the Number+Benefit headline formula (e.g., '5 Steps That Will Take You From Developer to ML Engineer'), a 📝-prefixed subtitle stating a clear benefit, a 🖼️ hero image placeholder, at least two '---' horizontal rule separators, at least 3 H2 body sections, and a 📚 related articles footer. (3) Apply SEO rules by placing the keyword 'machine learning for developers' in the first ~100 words of the body, in the title, and in at least one H2 heading. (4) Include a genuine CTA in the conclusion asking readers to 'clap' and/or 'follow'. (5) Write at least 600 words of substantive content. (6) NOT blindly copy the structurally broken draft. The primary traps are: the emoji section markers (📌/📝/🖼️/📚), the '---' separators, the CTA clap/follow requirement, and the strict 100-word SEO keyword placement rule — none of which a generic LLM would apply without reading SKILL.md.
